messages.subject: openCR SE estimates for Density
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to follow the instructions for calculating SEs of Density estimates from a multi-session openCR model: “derived does not yet provide delta-method SE or conﬁdence intervals for derived parameters. A reliable workaround for abundance paramaters (N, D) is to (i) infer the point estimates with derived, (ii) assemble a start vector on the link scale(s) for an equivalent full-likelihood openCR.fit model that includes the derived abundances, and (iii) run openCR.fit with method = "none" to compute the hessian at the MLE, and hence the full variance-covariance matrix”

I am at the last stage, and have generated a variance-covariance matrix on a version of the model using full-likelihood and start vectors, but the var-covar matrix does not include D.
Is it possible to calculate SEs for D as a next step using the variance for the other parameters? Are there any examples of this having been done that are published?
Advice would be much appreciated!

Many thanks,

Emily
